status: Editable preliminary assumptions, not approved loads or material allowables
lift_distribution: Elliptical over the supplied half span; normalized so the two exposed wings carry the full maneuver load. No inertial relief.
bulkhead_load_model: Both wing end faces receive upward shear and equal/opposite wing root bending moments. A distributed downward inertial load acts on the lower outside rim. Three constraints remove rigid modes only.
material_note: Assumed isotropic room-temperature elastic properties and conservative study stress ceiling. These are not certified 7050 forging allowables.
knockdown_note: Study allowance for imperfect restraints and initial shape. This chosen factor is not a validated imperfection model.
skin_bracing_note: Sensitivity case only. No skin or attachment stiffness exists in the current assembly. The unbraced case uses the full measured member length.
primary_local_model: Pocket floors: simply supported rectangular plates enclosing each pocket. Cross ribs: outstanding flat plates with one supported and one free longitudinal edge, k=0.43. Global bulkhead lateral buckling is not covered.

sources.title: NACA TN 3781, Handbook of Structural Stability Part I: Buckling of Flat Plates
sources.use: Classical elastic plate coefficients and boundary-condition sensitivity
